extraction_caveats:
1. This is a battery-electric vehicle (EM57 motor); there is no engine oil, spark plugs, air cleaner filter, or transmission fluid in the conventional sense. Reduction gear fluid (Genuine NISSAN Matic S ATF) replaces transmission fluid.
2. The maintenance schedule is presented as discrete mileage columns (7,500 / 15,000 / 22,500 / 30,000 … 120,000 miles). Repeat intervals were reconstructed by identifying the pattern across columns rather than listing each column individually.
3. Tire rotation appears at every 7,500-mile/6-month interval throughout the schedule (both standard and as part of severe intervals); it is recorded once with that repeat interval.
4. The standard 7,500-mile inspections (horn/lights, battery terminals, tire pressure, suspension components) repeat at every interval through 120,000 miles; only the base interval is recorded.
5. Intelligent Key battery: first INSPECT at 22,500 miles/18 months (months-only trigger per manual); first REPLACE at 45,000 miles/36 months, then at 67,500/54mo, 90,000/72mo, 112,500/90mo — the manual states 'performed based on the number of service months only.' The replace interval is approximately every 18 months after the first replacement.
6. Coolant first replacement: 125,000 miles or 15 years (180 months); subsequent interval: 75,000 miles or 5 years (60 months). Only the first-replacement interval is captured in first_at_miles/first_at_months; the subsequent interval differs and is noted in the notes field.
7. Brake fluid standard replacement interval is every 30,000 miles/24 months (appears at 30k, 60k, 90k, 120k miles in standard schedule). Severe-use brake fluid replacement is every 15,000 miles/12 months.
8. Charging port sealing cap inspection appears at 30k, 60k, 90k, 120k miles (every 30,000 miles/24 months) in the standard schedule.
9. In-cabin microfilter replacement appears at 15k, 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k miles — every 15,000 miles/12 months in the standard schedule.
10. Pages 564 (table of contents) and 568–569 (explanatory text) were used for context; the actual schedule data comes from pages 570–577. Page 581 provides fluid capacities and specifications.
11. The 37,500-mile/30-month and 67,500-mile/54-month and 97,500-mile/78-month severe-use entries explicitly state 'Not applicable. Proceed to next interval.'
12. Severe-use items at 15,000 miles/12 months: the pages show axle & suspension parts, front suspension ball joints, steering gear and linkage, steering linkage ball joints as inspections, plus brake fluid replacement as essential. Brake pads & rotors and drive shaft boots are NOT listed as severe items at 15,000 miles (they appear at 7,500 severe but not 15,000 severe per page 571).
corrections: Intelligent Key battery replace: notes old -> 'then at 75k/60mo, 90k/72mo, 112.5k/90mo, 120k/96mo' new -> 'then at 67,500/54mo, 90k/72mo, 112.5k/90mo (approximately every 18 months after first replacement)'. Per pages 572 (45k/36mo first replace), 574 (67.5k/54mo), 576 (90k/72mo), 577 (112.5k/90mo). The original incorrectly listed 75k/60mo as a replacement point; page 574 shows 67.5k/54mo is the replace, while 75k/60mo has no Intelligent Key battery action. Also 120k/96mo is not listed as a replacement point on page 577 (120k shows standard inspections only, no IK battery replace).

Extraction caveat 5: old -> 'then at 75k/60mo, 90k/72mo, 112.5k/90mo, 120k/96mo' new -> 'then at 67,500/54mo, 90,000/72mo, 112,500/90mo'. Corrected per pages 574, 576, 577. The interval is approximately every 18 months, not 30 months as originally stated.

Added extraction caveat 12 noting that severe-use items at 15,000 miles per page 571 do NOT include brake pads & rotors or drive shaft boots (those only appear at 7,500 severe). The first-pass JSON had these items listed at 15,000 severe which is not supported — however they were not present in the maintenance_items at 15,000 severe, so no item removal was needed. The existing severe items at 15,000 (axle & suspension, front suspension ball joints, steering gear and linkage, steering linkage ball joints, brake fluid) are correct per page 571.
